key_insight: Output format significantly influences clinical triage performance in consumer LLMs, rather than clinical knowledge itself.
clinical_relevance: Recognizing how output format affects decision-making in AI can improve triage accuracy in clinical settings.
method: Utilized sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features in clinical narratives.
Analyzed performance across free-text and multiple-choice formats.
Applied three independent methods for verification: verbalization, logit attribution, and feature characterization.
evidence_signal: Consistent medical features were identified across both output formats, indicating preserved clinical representation despite divergent performance.
watch_item: Further investigation is needed to ensure AI models maintain their accuracy across various question formats in real-world applications.
paper_title: Internal Representation, Not Clinical Knowledge: Where Apparent LLM Triage Failures Originate
